correctness.rationale: The x to (a,b=a+x2) triangular map has determinant one and identifies the rectangular two-row order polytope. Stanley chambers are equally likely and are counted by Catalan Dyck words; independent uniform order statistics generate volume. The rank gap d_j is the sum of up/down Dyck heights at their ranks. Tight Dyck maximum and exponential-spacing uniform concentration give the exact sqrt(m) coordinate limit with sqrt(2) factor. Beta conditional moments and Dyck maximum moment bounds provide uniform integrability. Excursion as 3-dimensional Brownian-bridge radius and KL eigenvalues produce the claimed Laplace product; differentiating verifies mean 1 and variance 4/15. Independent exact Dyck/Beta enumeration gives finite E[Q_m] for m=1..8; these approach but do not prove the limit.

limitations: Only two-row upper vector (1,0) lower zero; canonical coordinate Euclidean metric, not arbitrary flows or numbers of rows.
